summary: Gold Fields Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its hybrid Annual General Meeting held on 21 May 2026. All resolutions were passed by the requisite majority, including reappointment of auditors, election and re-election of directors, advisory endorsements of remuneration policy and report, approval for issuing equity securities for cash, and special resolutions on non-executive director fees. Voting results show high approval percentages across resolutions, with notable 77.37% support for re-election of director TP Goodlace. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation event.
